appraisal_events.evidence: Adieu pour toujours, ma petite Albertine, et merci encore de la bonne promenade que nous fîmes ensemble la veille de notre séparation. J'en garde un bien bon souvenir.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator addresses Albertine with tender gratitude, framing their last shared walk as a cherished, fondly remembered moment even amid final separation.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine is remembered warmly and gratefully in this farewell, given a positive, endorsed framing despite the finality of the parting.

ambiguities: The speaker and precise circumstance of this quoted farewell are not fully clear from the passage alone; it is read here as the narrator's own address to Albertine.
